title: Crew Arrival, Waiting and Clearance Terms for Installation Jobs
content:
These terms govern the crew's arrival and the customer's side of access on every crew day of an **Installation Jobs** record, by installation method.

## Arrival window and late arrival

| Installation method | Arrival window starts (local time) | Window length (hours) | Grace after the window ends (minutes) | Late-arrival credit per crew day (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 08:00 | 2 | 60 | 50.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation | 08:00 | 2 | 60 | 50.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 08:00 | 2 | 60 | 50.00 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 08:00 | 2 | 60 | 75.00 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 08:00 | 2 | 60 | 75.00 |
| Door System Installation | 08:00 | 2 | 60 | 50.00 |

## Access and clearance

| Installation method | Crew waits for access after arriving (minutes) | Clear space in front of every opening inside the home (feet) | Failed-access fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 30 | 3 | 195.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation | 30 | 3 | 225.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 30 | 3 | 225.00 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 30 | 3 | 275.00 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 30 | 3 | 295.00 |
| Door System Installation | 30 | 3 | 195.00 |

## Notes

1. The window opens at the start time and lasts the stated hours; with the figures above, every method's window runs from 08:00 to 10:00, and a crew arrival counts as late only when it comes more than 60 minutes after the window ends.
2. The failed-access fee is the method's fee for a visit at which the crew cannot get access or the work area is not cleared.

## Reading the terms (hypothetical examples)

- Hypothetically, a crew on a Masonry Opening Installation job arriving at 11:00 is exactly 60 minutes after the window ends and is not late; an arrival at 11:01 is more than 60 minutes after it.
- A hypothetical Bay and Bow Installation job carries a failed-access fee figure of 295.00 and a late-arrival credit figure of 75.00.
